name: oracle-firefox
description: Run durable, Pro-verified ChatGPT consultations with safe failure recovery and completion handoffs through one shared Firefox broker.

interface.shortDescription: Durable ChatGPT Pro consultation through Firefox.
interface.longDescription: Oracle Firefox runs one authenticated Firefox and one durable broker per user. It safely queues standalone, project, and existing-chat messages, verifies Pro before sending, classifies failed responses, optionally sends one authorized recovery continuation, emits private completion handoffs, survives restarts, supports structured local-evidence follow-ups, and downloads generated files read-only.
defaultPrompt: Get a Firefox-backed second opinion on this code.
Ask ChatGPT to review these files in a project through Firefox.
Continue an existing ChatGPT conversation through Firefox.
